structure.layout: single-column centered download page (1024px content) with floating sticky pill nav, centered hero, framed product demo, divided alternatives list, multi-column footer

aesthetics.typography: Geist for headings, body, nav and links; Geist Mono for small uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows/section labels ('DOWNLOAD', 'OTHER WAYS TO RUN FLOE', footer column heads), version meta line, window title bar and status line
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 60px/600 H1 vs 18px subtitle, 18px row titles, 14px body/links, 13px fine print, 11-12px mono letter-spaced labels

notes: Near-black monochrome dark theme with a single pale-blue accent used only for mono eyebrow text and the room code in the demo status bar. Nav is a fully-rounded floating pill that sticks to the top; active page gets a gray pill, GitHub is an inverted white pill button. The product demo is framed like an OS window with mono title bar ('FLOE DESKTOP · 1.1.1') and terminal-like status footer ('room open · code quiet-fetch-sled'), with a soft glow/shadow behind. Alternative-download section is a 3-column definition-style list separated by hairlines with right-aligned bold text links. Copy is precise and plain-spoken (SmartScreen instructions, checksums).
